# Electrical circuits: catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalogue.py from the code; do not edit by hand. -->

Electrical circuits: resistors, capacitors, inductors, sources and their waveforms, diodes, switches, transformers and controlled sources (Modelica Standard Library device laws); impedances, constant-power loads and power converters (Modelica Buildings Library laws); Joule heating into a thermal network; the reader of OpenModelica circuit exports; balanced AC and DC power flow in per unit (MATPOWER branch model, shunts, voltage-controlled generators) and the MATPOWER case-file reader. How the pieces fit together: [Electrical circuits](../../applications/electrical/index.md).
Every application is set up the same way; see [Using noodl](../../guide/workflow.md).

Import from `noodl.apps.electrical` and the modules named in each table. Each name links to its entry in the [API reference](../api/index.md), which gives every parameter.

## Set-up

Build the model and its starting state and inputs.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`build_model`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.build_model)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | Assemble the circuit model and return `(model, state, drivers)`. |
| [`initial_state`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.analysis.initial_state)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | The consistent initial state at time `t` (s), the start of a transient: every capacitor at its `v0`, every inductor (and transformer winding) at its `i0`, sources at their value at `t`, and the other voltages and currents consistent with those (`solve_kwargs`, such as Newton's `atol` and `rtol`, reach the layer solve). |
| [`build_power_flow`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.build.build_power_flow)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | The AC power flow of `net` as `(model, state, drivers)`, by the build rules of `noodl.apps.electrical.power.build`; the network is checked first (`check_power_network`). |
| [`dc_power_flow`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.dc.dc_power_flow)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | The DC power flow of `net` as `(model, state, drivers)`, by the build rules of `noodl.apps.electrical.power.dc`; solve it with `solve_power_flow`. |

## Network components

Descriptions of the physical objects a network is built from.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`Capacitor`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.Capacitor)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A capacitor `i = C dv/dt` (`C` in F), with initial voltage `v0` (V). |
| [`Circuit`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.Circuit)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A netlist: `devices` (the dataclasses of this module) between named nodes, and the `ground` node (0 V). |
| [`Conductor`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.Conductor)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A linear conductance `i = G v` (`G` in S). |
| [`ControlledSource`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.ControlledSource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A linear controlled source: port 1 senses (`control="voltage"`: an open circuit; `"current"`: a short) and port 2 imposes (`output="voltage"` or `"current"`) `gain` times the sensed quantity. |
| [`CurrentSource`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.CurrentSource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An ideal current source `i = offset + I unit(t)` (A) entering pin `p` (flowing through the source from `p` to `n`); waveform and AC phasor as for `VoltageSource`. |
| [`Diode`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.Diode)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A junction diode `i = Ids (exlin(v / Vt) - 1) + v / R` (`Ids` in A, `Vt` in V, `R` the parallel leak in ohm; exponential up to `Maxexp`, linear above). |
| [`IdealTransformer`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.IdealTransformer)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An ideal transformer `v1 = n v2`, `i2 = -n i1` (turns ratio `n`). |
| [`Inductor`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.Inductor)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An inductor `v = L di/dt` (`L` in H), with initial current `i0` (A). |
| [`Resistor`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.Resistor)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A linear resistor `v = R_actual i`, `R_actual = R (1 + alpha (T - T_ref))` (`R` in ohm at `T_ref` in K, `alpha` in 1/K); `T` comes from the builder's `temperature` driver, else `T = T_ref`. |
| [`Switch`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.Switch)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An ideal closing switch: closed `v = Ron i`, open `i = Goff v` (`Ron` in ohm, `Goff` in S); closed where its control value exceeds 0.5. |
| [`Transformer`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.Transformer)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | Two coupled windings `v1 = L1 di1/dt + M di2/dt`, `v2 = M di1/dt + L2 di2/dt` (H), with initial currents `i0 = (i1, i2)` (A). |
| [`VoltageSource`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.circuit.VoltageSource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An ideal voltage source `v = offset + V unit(t)` (V), `unit` the waveform. |
| [`Branch`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.network.Branch)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | A line or transformer from `from_bus` to `to_bus`: series resistance `r`, reactance `x` and total line charging susceptance `b` (p.u. on `base_mva`), off-nominal turns ratio `ratio` at the from end (0 means 1) and phase shift `shift_deg` (degrees). |
| [`Bus`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.network.Bus)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | A bus: its id, kind (one of `BUS_KINDS`), voltage magnitude `vm` (p.u.) and angle `va_deg` (degrees) as stated in the file (the slack bus's angle is its setpoint), and its base voltage `base_kv` (kV, informative). |
| [`DcPowerFlowSolution`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.dc.DcPowerFlowSolution)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | A solved DC power flow in per unit; tensors may carry leading batch dimensions. |
| [`FixedShunt`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.network.FixedShunt)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | A fixed admittance from `bus` to ground, stated as the real power `g_mw` (MW) it consumes and the reactive power `b_mvar` (MVAr) it injects at a bus voltage of 1 p.u. |
| [`Generator`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.network.Generator)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | A generator on `bus`: real output `p_mw` (MW), reactive output `q_mvar` (MVAr, a starting value), voltage magnitude setpoint `vm_set` (p.u.) and reactive limits (MVAr). |
| [`Load`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.network.Load)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | A constant-power load on `bus`, absorbing `p_mw` (MW) and `q_mvar` (MVAr). |
| [`PowerFlowIndex`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.build.PowerFlowIndex)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | How a `PowerNetwork` maps onto a power-flow model. |
| [`PowerFlowSolution`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.build.PowerFlowSolution)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | A solved power flow in per unit; tensors may carry leading batch dimensions. |
| [`PowerNetwork`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.network.PowerNetwork)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | A power-flow network: buses, branches, generators, loads and fixed shunts in file order, the system base `base_mva` (MVA), a `name` and free-form `notes` (a reader records what it skipped there; they take no part in equality or the hash, so a network is hashable). |

## Constitutive laws

The relation between the flow through an edge and the potential difference across it.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`Capacitance`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.laws.Capacitance)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A capacitor `q = C d(dp)/dt` (`C` in F, initial voltage `v0` in V), in the form of each mode: dc `q = 0`; initial `dp = v0`; phasor `q = j omega C dp`; transient backward Euler `q = C (dp - dp_prev) / dt` or trapezoidal `q + q_prev = 2 C / dt (dp - dp_prev)`. |
| [`ConstantPowerLoad`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.loads.ConstantPowerLoad)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A load absorbing the complex power `S = P + jQ` (W, var; positive = consumption, the power-flow convention), per edge: `q = conj(S / dp)`, on a real layer `q = P / dp`. |
| [`DependentSource`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.laws.DependentSource)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A linear controlled source with edges `[control, output]` per device: the control port is an open circuit (`q1 = 0`, voltage control) or a short (`dp1 = 0`, current control), and the output port imposes `dp2` (voltage output) or `q2` (current output) as `gain` times the control voltage `dp1` or current `q1`. |
| [`Impedance`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.loads.Impedance)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A series impedance `dp = (R + jX) q` with the reactance `X = omega L - 1/(omega C)` (`R` in ohm, `L` in H, `C` in F; `C = inf`, the default, is no capacitance) at the phasor layer's angular frequency `omega`. |
| [`ImpedanceTransformer`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.converters.ImpedanceTransformer)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An ideal transformer behind a series primary impedance: `dp1 = Z q1 + n dp2`, `q2 = -n q1` (winding ratio `n`, primary to secondary voltage; complex primary impedance `Z` in ohm, per device). |
| [`Inductance`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.laws.Inductance)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An inductor `dp = L dq/dt` (`L` in H, initial current `i0` in A), in the form of each mode: dc `dp = 0`; initial `q = i0`; phasor `dp = j omega L q`; transient backward Euler `dp = L (q - q_prev) / dt` or trapezoidal `dp + dp_prev = 2 L / dt (q - q_prev)`. |
| [`JunctionDiode`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.laws.JunctionDiode)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A junction diode with a parallel leak: `q = Ids (exlin(dp / Vt) - 1) + dp / R`, where `exlin(x) = exp(x)` up to `Maxexp` and continues linearly above it, `exp(Maxexp) (1 + x - Maxexp)` (`Ids` saturation current in A, `Vt` voltage equivalent of temperature in V, `R` parallel resistance in ohm). |
| [`MutualInductance`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.laws.MutualInductance)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | Two coupled windings: `dp1 = L1 dq1/dt + M dq2/dt`, `dp2 = M dq1/dt + L2 dq2/dt` (`L1`, `L2`, `M` in H; initial currents `i0 = (i1, i2)` in A, per device or shared). |
| [`PowerConverter`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.converters.PowerConverter)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An AC/DC converter with a constant efficiency, in a phasor layer whose direct-current side is a complex node with zero imaginary part. |
| [`PrescribedCurrent`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.laws.PrescribedCurrent)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An ideal current source: `q = offset + amplitude * unit(t)` (A) entering pin `p` whatever the voltage, with the waveform and its phasor as for `PrescribedVoltage`. |
| [`PrescribedVoltage`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.laws.PrescribedVoltage)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An ideal voltage source: `dp = offset + amplitude * unit(t)` (V), with `unit` the waveform (`Constant` by default; one for all edges or one per edge) evaluated at the evaluation time `t` (s). |
| [`Resistance`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.laws.Resistance)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A linear resistor: `q = dp / R_actual` with `R_actual = R s (1 + alpha (T - T_ref))` (`R` in ohm at `T_ref` in K, `alpha` in 1/K); `T` (K) is read per edge from `drivers[temperature]` when `temperature` names a driver, else `T = T_ref`; `s` is read per edge from `drivers[scale]` when `scale` names a driver (a variable resistor whose resistance follows a signal), else `s = 1`. |
| [`SwitchedConductance`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.laws.SwitchedConductance)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An ideal closing switch: closed `q = dp / Ron`, open `q = Goff dp` (`Ron` in ohm, `Goff` in S); closed where the control value exceeds 0.5 (or is True). |
| [`TransformerRatio`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.laws.TransformerRatio)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An ideal transformer without magnetisation: `dp1 = n dp2`, `q2 = -n q1` (turns ratio `n`, primary to secondary voltage). |
| [`PiBranch`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.laws.PiBranch)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | MATPOWER's branch two-port in per unit, `[I_f; I_t] = [[Y_ff, Y_ft], [Y_tf, Y_tt]] [V_f; V_t]` with `Y_s = 1/(r + jx)`, `tau = ratio e^{j shift}`, `Y_tt = Y_s + jb/2`, `Y_ff = Y_tt/(tau conj(tau))`, `Y_ft = -Y_s/conj(tau)`, `Y_tf = -Y_s/tau`. |
| [`Shunt`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.laws.Shunt)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | A constant-admittance shunt, `i = (g + jb) v` (p.u.), per edge bus -> ground: `g` consumes the real power `g \|v\|^2` and a positive `b` injects the reactive power `b \|v\|^2` (a capacitor). |
| [`VoltageControlledGenerator`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.laws.VoltageControlledGenerator)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | A generator injecting the real power `P` (p.u.) at the voltage magnitude `V` (p.u.), per edge bus -> ground: `residual(v, i) = (\|v\| - V) + j (Re(v conj(i)) + P)`. |

## Closures

Functions of the state that compute drivers each step (densities, flows, levels).

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`HeatedEdge`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.thermal.HeatedEdge)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A circuit device with a heat port: its edge `edge` (position in the electrical layer's `q`), its end nodes `p` and `n` (positions in `phi`), the network node `heat_node` of its heat port (a node of the heat layer: interior, where the heat goes, or a boundary at a fixed temperature, which absorbs it), and the per-edge temperature driver `temperature_key` its law reads, at position `slot` of that driver. |
| [`JouleHeating`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.thermal.JouleHeating)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A coupling closure `closure(state, drivers) -> driver updates` between a circuit layer (`electrical`) and a heat layer (`thermal`, a `TransportLayer`) on one network. |

## Waveforms

Time signals a source follows.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`Constant`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.waveforms.Constant)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A constant: unit value 1 at every time (a DC source: value `offset + amplitude`). |
| [`Pulse`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.waveforms.Pulse)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A pulse train: 1 for the first `width` percent of every `period` (s) from `start_time`, else 0; `n_periods < 0` repeats for ever, otherwise the pulse train stops after `n_periods` periods (MSL `Blocks.Sources.Pulse`). |
| [`Ramp`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.waveforms.Ramp)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A ramp: 0 before `start_time` (s), rising linearly to 1 over `duration` (s), then 1 (MSL `Blocks.Sources.Ramp`; `duration = 0` is a step). |
| [`Signal`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.waveforms.Signal)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | An external signal: the unit value is read from the driver `drivers[key][..., index]` at evaluation time (batched like any driver), so a source can follow an external input (MSL `SignalVoltage`, `SignalCurrent`). |
| [`Sine`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.waveforms.Sine)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A sine wave: 0 before `start_time` (s), then `sin(2 pi frequency (t - start_time) + phase)` (`frequency` in Hz, `phase` in rad; MSL `Blocks.Sources.Sine` with `continuous = false`). |
| [`Step`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.waveforms.Step)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | A step: 0 before `start_time` (s), 1 from `start_time` on (MSL `Blocks.Sources.Step`: `if time < startTime then 0 else height`). |

## Functions

Calculations and helpers.

| Name | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`ac_sweep`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.analysis.ac_sweep)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | The sinusoidal steady state of `circuit` at each of `frequencies` (Hz), one batched phasor solve: `{"frequency": (F,), "electrical.phi": (F, n), "electrical.q": (F, b)}`, complex peak-amplitude, sine-referenced phasors (`x(t) = \|X\| sin(omega t + arg X)`). |
| [`device_values`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.analysis.device_values)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | Per device name, its `(voltage, current)` (V, A) in `state`: `v = v_p - v_n` and the current entering pin `p`, each of shape `(...,)` for a one-port device and `(..., 2)` (port 1, port 2) for a two-port device. |
| [`operating_point`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.analysis.operating_point)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | The DC operating point at time `t` (s): capacitors open, inductors shorted, sources at their value at `t` (`model.steady`; `solve_kwargs`, such as Newton's `atol` and `rtol`, reach the layer solve). |
| [`transient`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.analysis.transient)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical`</small> | March the circuit over the time grid `times` (s), from `state` at `times[0]` (usually `initial_state`), one `Model.step` per interval. |
| [`extrapolate`](../api/shared.md#noodl.modelica.timeline.extrapolate)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.modelica`</small> | Richardson extrapolation of two run histories on the same `"time"`s, `fine` with half the step of `coarse` (twice the `substeps`), of a method of order `order`: `fine + (fine - coarse)/(2**order - 1)` for every entry but `"time"`. |
| [`simulate_circuit`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.modelica.run.simulate_circuit)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.modelica`</small> | The circuit's history at `times` (default `names.times`; each must be a time of `names.grid`, increasing; a single time may be a scalar): `"time"` `(T,)` (the grid times found, a new tensor) and every `".phi"`, `".q"`, `".x"` and `".storage_flow"` state entry the model returns, stacked on dim 0. |
| [`check_power_network`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.build.check_power_network)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | Check that `net` is a solvable power-flow network and return its `PowerFlowIndex`. |
| [`dc_power_flow_solution`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.dc.dc_power_flow_solution)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | Bus angles, generation per generator bus and branch flows of a solved DC power flow (`model` from `dc_power_flow`). |
| [`matpower_case`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.cases.matpower_case)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | The path of MATPOWER 8.1's case `name` (one of `MATPOWER_CASES`), downloaded on first use and verified by SHA-256 on every call. |
| [`power_flow_solution`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.build.power_flow_solution)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | Bus voltages, generation per generator bus and branch end powers of a solved AC power flow (`model` from `build_power_flow`). |
| [`solve_power_flow`](../api/electrical.md#noodl.apps.electrical.power.build.solve_power_flow)<br><small>`noodl.apps.electrical.power`</small> | The solved power flow, AC or DC: `model.steady(state, drivers, atol=atol, rtol=rtol, max_iter=max_iter, **solve_kwargs)`, for a model from `build_power_flow` or `dc_power_flow`. |
